artworks.title: The Deposition from the Cross
artworks.medium: paste print on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows irregular and jagged shapes along with a grid of straight and curved lines, forming a dynamic and complex pattern. The dark and light contrasts hint at outlines resembling figures. The overall impression is of an ancient manuscript or artistic tapestry, with obscured details.

artworks.title: The Flagellation of Christ
artworks.medium: paste print on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a textured and aged abstract composition. The image features a rectangular shape filled with intricate patterns. The edges of the piece are bordered with repetitive linear design elements. The dominant color scheme consists of shades of brown, black, and off-white. The painting's surface appears worn, akin to ancient artwork or an artifact. The style suggests an abstract representation.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands
artworks.medium: paste print on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting an abstract composition with intricate pattern-like details. The image features dark brown and black hues against a lighter background, with intricate details forming floral or ornamental patterns amid a grid-like framework. The worn condition of the design suggests an aged or distressed surface, reminiscent of an ancient manuscript or textile. The composition has a symmetrical quality, with a repeating arrangement visible along the edges. The style of the painting may suggest influences from early woodcuts or etchings, evoking an old-world or historical aesthetic.

artworks.title: Saint James Major
artworks.medium: black and white chalks on light brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a man's upper body. He is seated and turned slightly to the left. The man has a pronounced nose, prominent cheekbones, and dark, flowing hair that falls to his shoulder. His facial hair includes a mustache and a goatee. The man is depicted wearing a dark garment. He is holding a large wooden object in his left hand. The background is textured, shaded brown with some areas lighter than others, giving the image depth. The overall tone of the image is dark and monochromatic, with subtle highlights used on the man's face and the object he holds.

artworks.title: A Young Man in a Broad Hat
artworks.medium: black and white chalks on light brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body depiction of a person, captured from the torso upwards. The individual is turned towards the viewer with their head slightly turned to the side, giving a three-quarter profile view of their face. This person has delicate facial features with a focused gaze directed towards the viewer. Their hair appears wavy and falls to the side, just peeking out from under a wide-brimmed hat. The attire consists of a draped garment with visible folds; there are no visible patterns or jewelry adorning their clothing. The left hand of the person is partially visible, with fingers extending towards the bottom right corner of the image. The background is plain, with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: A Young Woman Fixing Her Hair
artworks.medium: black, white, and red chalks on blue laid paper faded to tan, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person with their back towards the viewer. The individual's head and shoulders are visible, showing a side profile of their face as they slightly turn their head to the left. The person has delicate facial features, including a profile view of the nose and lips, with a gentle expression. They have dark hair styled in an updo secured with a white ribbon. The person is wearing a light-colored, off-the-shoulder garment with puffed sleeves, revealing part of their arm and a hoop earring in one ear. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: An Elderly Bishop
artworks.medium: black, white, and red chalks on light brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The drawing shows a partial profile view of an elderly male figure, focusing on the face and upper shoulders. The man has his head slightly turned to the right, with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and subtle lines suggesting age. His thinning hair curves back from his forehead, and he has a long beard and mustache. He appears to be wearing a garment covering his shoulders, and the background is plain. The artwork features soft shading and line work, with a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
artworks.medium: brush and gray ink over traces of graphite on vellum
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person in a seated position with a slight turn towards the left. The person has a round face, a defined nose, and curly hair framing their face. They are wearing a richly patterned garment with an intricate design and a lace collar around their neck. The background is plain, and the person is set within an oval frame.

artworks.title: The Muse Terpsichore
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a classical female figure standing on a pedestal. She is draped in flowing robes that contour her form, exposing one shoulder and arm. The figure holds a small object in her left hand and her right hand rests on an intricately carved element resembling an ornate scroll. The sculpture appears to be rendered in a monochromatic reddish-brown color, resembling terracotta. The figure is facing slightly to her left, with her head gently tilted.

artworks.title: Travelers in a Broad Valley
artworks.medium: gouache on prepared parchment
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains in the distance, a dirt path, a man leading a horse, another figure following with a dog, rustic buildings, foliage, trees, and cottages in the foothills. The trees have a range of greens and browns and the color palette is dominated by soft blues and earthy tones.

artworks.title: Saint Louis of Toulouse Holding a Staff
artworks.medium: pen and ink over stylus on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length sketch of a person standing upright. The figure is drawn facing forward, with one hand raised to chest level and the other hand holding a vertical object that resembles a staff. The person is wearing a long robe adorned with decorative elements around the chest area. They have a headpiece that resembles a miter. The facial features are lightly sketched, with a focus on the outline of the face and basic forms, and the hair is not distinctly detailed. Surrounding the person is a plain background with no distinct features. The artwork uses simple lines to convey the figure and its clothing.

artworks.title: Saint Louis of Toulouse Holding a Book
artworks.medium: pen and ink over stylus on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person from head to toe, standing upright. The facial features are simple, with basic lines for the eyes, nose, and mouth. The individual is wearing a long robe and headgear, possibly a crown or mitre. They are holding an object that could be a book or tablet. The background is plain, and the sketch has a loose, unfinished style.

artworks.title: Pluto Bringing Proserpine to the Gates of Hell
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: This drawing features mythological figures and a three-headed creature. It is rendered in a monochrome sepia tone, giving it an antiquated appearance. The image depicts two muscular figures, one wearing a crown. Both figures are shown in dynamic postures; the crowned figure has a flowing cape. A three-headed creature is seen nearby. The scene is enclosed within a circular border.

artworks.title: The Villa Imperiale
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brown wash, and incised on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a top-down view of an architectural scene drawn with pen-and-ink. The composition includes various structures, an elliptical base with inscriptions, a grand building with archways and multiple floors, lush trees in the background, and a monochrome color palette with fine line work and cross-hatching for shading and texture.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.artist: Cristofano Robetta, after Antonio del Pollaiuolo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.7 x 19.9 cm (10 1/2 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two muscular figures in a dynamic struggle. One figure is lifting the other above its head. The background includes rocky terrain and scattered clouds. A small winged creature is depicted to the right. Strong lines and careful shading define muscles and contours.

artworks.title: Patience d'eau, étude (Study of a Patience-Dock)
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and roulette on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Fine and Larry Day in memory of George Parides
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of dense plant life next to a small body of water. Large leaves and tall grasses are depicted with fine lines. In the background, there is a weathered stone structure partially hidden by vegetation. The monochrome palette emphasizes light and shadow in the intricate natural scene.

artworks.title: Angelus Ministrans
artworks.medium: brush and gold paint on wove paper prepared with black watercolor
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 25 x 13.3 cm (9 13/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
overall: 35.6 x 27.9 cm (14 x 11 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, holding a long staff in their left hand, which extends from the ground up beyond their shoulder. The person is gazing slightly to their left. Their hands suggest they are resting or possibly clasping something. The facial features are delicate and softly outlined; the person has wavy hair that is longer on the sides, secured with a headband or wrap, and flows down around the face. Their attire consists of a voluminous, draped garment that falls in multiple folds down to their feet, suggesting movement or depth. A tied sash at the waist gathers the garment. In the background, the scene has a dark, almost monochrome appearance, emphasizing the light and shaded contrast of the figure, which adds a dramatic element to the composition. The background lacks distinct elements, focusing attention on the figure itself.

artworks.title: Magnificent Catafalque in Honor of John III, King of Poland
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray inks with gray wash over graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Peter W. Josten in memory of Stephen Spector
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural or sculptural monument. The drawing depicts a highly ornate structure with classical and Baroque elements, featuring multiple decorative columns, statues, and intricate reliefs. The monument is adorned with various sculptural details including urns, medallions, and human figures, topped with tall spires and flames. The composition highlights the grandeur and opulence of the design, with precise lines and shading emphasizing the depth and perspective. The careful attention to detail suggests the artist's focus on both architectural accuracy and artistic embellishment.

artworks.title: The Exploded Tower, Heidelberg Castle
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: This image shows an old stone ruin surrounded by foliage. The structure has archways and is covered in vines and trees. A wooden fence runs in the foreground. The color palette is monochromatic, highlighting textures and contrasts. Light and shadow play up the decay of the structure.

artworks.title: Passage des Deux-Soeurs de la rue Lafayette
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a cobblestone street in an urban setting. The street is narrow and surrounded by buildings. Some buildings are old with shuttered windows, while others are more modern. A sign that reads "VINS No 10" is visible in the distance, suggesting small establishments along the street. The color palette is sepia, highlighting the aged architecture. The cobblestones lead the eye into the distance, creating a warm and muted ambiance.

artworks.title: Chalet de Handeck, Hasli Valley, Canton Bern, Switzerland
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with rugged terrain. Snow-capped mountains dominate the horizon with jagged peaks. Tall pine trees are scattered across rocky terrain. Wooden structures blend into the landscape. The color palette is sepia, with soft shadows and highlights, creating depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Auguste Vacquerie at a Window, Marine Terrace
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body leaning out of a window. The person faces forward, looking outside. Their facial features are obscured due to the texture and lighting. The person appears to have light-colored hair and wears dark clothes. There is no visible jewelry, and they are not holding any object. The background is an exterior building wall with a window featuring shutters on both sides. Below the window is a section of the building's roof. The scene is in a vintage, sepia-toned style, giving it an aged appearance. The area around the person is textured, adding an artistic effect.

artworks.title: The Hunts of Maximilian: The Stag Hunt (August)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Brown Foundation, Inc., Houston
artworks.description: The image depicts a forest scene with an elevated point of view, showing various activities and landscapes. The horizon is high and marked by a line of trees. In the foreground, hunters and dogs are chasing a deer, surrounded by tall trees with detailed textures. The color palette includes browns, greens, and grays, creating a sense of age and enhancing the natural setting. Further away, more hunters and animals can be seen among a vast expanse of fading trees towards the horizon, emphasizing depth and scale.

artworks.title: Design for an Inlaid Circular Table Top, with Alternatives
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray and black washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (circular): 32.5 x 32.5 cm (12 13/16 x 12 13/16 in.)
mount: 42.8 x 40.6 cm (16 7/8 x 16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a circular design filled with intricate shapes and lines forming radial symmetry. At the center is a star-like pattern with multiple points radiating outward, surrounded by abstract motifs resembling ornate leaves and scrolls. Oval shapes, similar to the outline of leaves, are evenly distributed around the central star, each set within detailed ornamental designs. The composition is reminiscent of classic architectural elements and combines them into a unified circular form.
